steps.text: Factory waste is often acidic and can harm fish and rivers. Let's compare releasing it raw versus treating it first.
Tap “Release Untreated” to dump the acidic waste straight into the water.
See the pH drop — untreated acidic waste is dangerous for aquatic life.
Now tap “Neutralise First” to add a base and neutralise the acid before release.
This time the pH rises to about 7 — the water is SAFE. Neutralising waste before it reaches rivers protects the whole ecosystem.

coach.mission: Make factory waste safe before it reaches the river.
whenStuck: Try “Release Untreated”, then compare with “Neutralise First”.
Neutralising the acid first brings the pH near 7 — safe for fish.
whenWrong: Untreated acidic waste harms the river — neutralise it first to reach pH 7.
Add a base to cancel the acid before releasing.
whenCorrect: Safe! Neutralised waste protects aquatic life.
That's why factories must treat waste.
coach.done: You've seen why waste must be neutralised before release. Explore more, or move on.
